title: A Mixtape for the Playlist
author: Paloma Delacroix
blurb: Wendell Dravenmoor, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
